fixes.defect: T1 label absorbed the connector: 'raised the full year 2026 guidance to between $775 million and $845 million' was transcribed with metric 'guidance to'. The frozen T1 grammar has 'to' / 'between' as connectors, never as part of <label>.
fixes.fix: a label ending in a template connector (to, of, at, be, between, from, in, is, are, range) is not a label; the sentence names no metric, so nothing is transcribed
fixes.class: D (implementation bug); no rule, grammar or threshold changed
fixes.effect: IDCC: 2 one-sided UNKNOWN transcriptions removed; no D4 or D6 change in any replay case

not_fixed_contract_limits: grammar misses found in the replay (outlook tables / bullets with '|', a period stated in the preceding sentence or heading, a period after the range, list continuations, an unnamed metric) are the V2 grammar as frozen; widening it after seeing results would be a V3 contract
